specification.problem: Transient provider timeouts lose checkout sales because the first attempt is never retried.

requirements.text: Retry a timed-out card charge up to 3 times with exponential backoff.
Every retried charge reuses the provider idempotency key of the first attempt.
After the final failed attempt, write a dead-letter record.

acceptance.text: Exactly one additional provider call within 2 seconds using the same idempotency key.
A dead-letter record exists after the third timeout and no further calls are made.

tasks.title: Write dead-letter records after final failure
